coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits. The available sources describe no building size, age or owner-based exemptions. The ordinance is structured to operate alongside state antitrust laws.
coverage.other_conditions: Limited to residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits.

evidence.quoted_span: Defines a limited scope, covering residential rental property within Santa Ana city limits
It is structured to operate alongside existing and proposed state antitrust laws while providing stronger local protections

result.notes: I removed the software exemptions (public or aggregate historical data, affordable-housing compliance tools) from other_conditions. They describe the type of software a landlord uses, which is landlord conduct, not building, unit or owner coverage. They remain in the rule's exemptions field. I removed the Cartwright Act / Cal. Bus. & Prof. Code § 16729 reference from the summary because no supplied document mentions it. I set requires_unknown_facts to false because the rule covers ordinary residential rental property citywide. supersedes_state_rule stays false, supported by the 'operate alongside' language. All sources are secondary; the adopted ordinance text was not available to confirm scope.
